key_insight: The paper builds the first large-scale spin-polarized electronic-structure database for stable halide double perovskites, revealing many compositionally diverse candidates with visible-band gaps and half-metallicity.
engineering_relevance: This dataset gives materials engineers a searchable foundation for screening perovskites for photovoltaics, photocatalysis, radiation detection, and spintronic functionality.
method: Hybrid-functional DFT calculations for >2,500 predicted-stable Cs2BB'X6 compounds.
Spin-polarized density of states analysis plus chemical-bonding evaluation with LOBSTER.
UMAP visualizations and an interactive app for composition, electronic structure, and magnetic-property exploration.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports >2,500 compounds in the database, including 719 with visible-range band gaps and 118 with half-metallic character.
watch_item: The dataset is limited to compounds predicted stable by the tau tolerance factor, so real-world performance still needs experimental validation and synthesis feasibility checks.
paper_title: Spin-Polarized Electronic Structure and Chemical Bonding Data for 2,500+ Halide Double Perovskites
